---
output: html_document
params:
  revision: null
  logo: ""
  decoration: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 5.8, fig.height = 3.0, dpi = 120)
r = params$revision
compact = identical(r$type, "ESSENTIEL")
identite = eduschool::identite_revision(r)
```

```{r entete, results='asis'}
if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  cat(eduschool:::.css_fiche_eduschool(), "\n")
  cat(eduschool:::.bandeau_revision_html(r, params$logo, params$decoration), "\n")
} else {
  info_entete = eduschool:::.infos_entete_math(r$niveau_id, r$titre)
  cat(
    eduschool:::.entete_math_rmd(
      info_entete,
      logo = params$logo,
      format = "latex"
    ),
    sep = "\n"
  )
  cat("\n\\begin{center}{\\Large\\bfseries ", identite$type, "}\\end{center}\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

`r r$description`

```{r blocs, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(r$blocs))) {
  b = r$blocs[i, ]
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    cat('<div class="eduschool-bloc" style="--edu-accent:', identite$couleur, '">\n', sep = "")
  }
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    cat("\n## ", b$titre, "\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("\n\\subsection*{\\Large\\bfseries ", b$titre, "}\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (nzchar(b$contenu)) cat(b$contenu, "\n\n")
  if (nzchar(b$formule)) cat(eduschool:::.formule_math_markdown(b$formule))
  if (nzchar(b$illustration_id)) {
    asset = eduschool:::.illustration_revision(b$illustration_id)
    if (nzchar(asset) && knitr::is_latex_output()) {
      cat("\\begin{center}\n")
      cat("\\includegraphics[width=0.48\\linewidth]{\\detokenize{", asset, "}}\n", sep = "")
      cat("\\end{center}\n")
    } else if (nzchar(asset)) {
      print(knitr::include_graphics(asset, dpi = 220))
    } else {
      eduschool:::.dessiner_revision(b$illustration_id)
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) cat("</div>\n")
}
```

```{r notions, results='asis'}
if (!compact && nrow(r$notions)) {
  cat("\n## Pour aller plus loin\n\n")
  for (x in unique(r$notions$libelle)) if (!is.na(x) && nzchar(x)) cat("- ", x, "\n", sep = "")
}
```
